summary: Design domain data products, SLOs, and federated governance in a practical data mesh course. Explore the five-day curriculum and enrol.
lede: Data mesh architecture training helps data leaders, architects, platform managers, and senior engineers plan distributed data ownership and governed data products. Participants map domains and ownership, define product contracts and service-level objectives, and assess self-serve platform capabilities. They also draft federated governance policies for quality, metadata, access, and change, then shape a phased adoption roadmap that accounts for dependencies and integration needs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior professionals responsible for changing how an organization owns, publishes, governs, and consumes data across business domains.
modules: Data Mesh Foundations and Operating Context
prerequisites: Prior experience with data platforms, data engineering, enterprise data architecture, or data governance is recommended. Coding is not required. Bring a working understanding of how your organization sources, manages, and shares data; no software installation is required for the architecture workshops.
